briefs.headline: Your discoveries live in Threads
briefs.body: Threads keeps the rules you discover through play. Open it with the shown key, M by default. Its Lessons button also holds every survival lesson from the start.
briefs.action: Open Lessons whenever you need a survival reminder.

briefs.headline: Quiet meters are still watching
briefs.body: Survival meters fade when their values are calm, leaving the view uncluttered. Hold Sneak whenever you need to reveal every managed meter and assess your condition.
briefs.action: Hold Sneak for a full status check.

briefs.headline: Clear water is earned
briefs.body: Thirst and water purity are separate constraints. Collect rain, melt snow near a campfire, and carry bottles in Curios slots; purity level three is safe to drink.

briefs.headline: Full is not nourished
briefs.body: Hunger measures immediate fuel, while nutrition tracks six food groups over time. Repeating one excellent meal can still leave neglected groups dangerously low afterward.
briefs.action: Open nutrition and choose foods for your lowest groups.

briefs.headline: New foods build lasting health
briefs.body: A varied menu does more than balance nutrients. Eating enough distinct foods permanently raises maximum health, so unfamiliar ingredients are valuable milestones instead of disposable curiosities.
briefs.action: Try foods you have never eaten.

briefs.headline: Borrowed speed leaves a debt
briefs.body: Sugar can quicken your cadence, but it accelerates nutrient expenditure and leaves debt behind. Alcohol offers a moderate composure window; excess turns the bargain against you.

briefs.headline: Your body has weather
briefs.body: World temperature and body temperature are different pressures. Clothing, shelter, biome, season, and thermal foods can push the balance, so prepare before entering an extreme climate.

briefs.headline: Your body has more motions
briefs.body: Advanced movement spends stamina. Fast run uses Shift, vault uses Mouse 5, and direct dodge uses R; directional double-tap dodging is disabled. Practice these actions on safe ground.
briefs.action: Practice movement before danger finds you.

briefs.headline: Sleep advances the world
briefs.body: A bed is not a frozen checkpoint. Sleep simulates the passing hours quickly, advancing weather, ecology, temperature, and active threats while your vulnerable world continues moving.

briefs.headline: Defeat is not immediate death
briefs.body: Falling can begin a recoverable downed state. A companion revives by holding Use while aiming at you; hold Sneak only when you intend to give up.
briefs.action: Protect downed allies and hold Use.

briefs.headline: A life chooses what it becomes
briefs.body: Life stats create irreversible strengths within one lifetime and reset on death. Constitution helps conserve hunger, thirst, and stamina, while other choices shape different long-term capabilities.

briefs.headline: Seasons turn the work
briefs.body: The calendar changes which crops and trees grow well. Observe seasonal feedback, preserve surplus from productive months, and expect familiar land to demand a different plan later.

briefs.headline: Weather has momentum
briefs.body: Storms are systems with motion, not decorative flashes. Watch the sky, listen for escalation, and keep a defensible route indoors before severe weather overtakes exposed work.

briefs.headline: Industry changes the air
briefs.body: Pollution moves with the world and can harm living things. Detect it, protect yourself, route emitters through chimneys and filters, then clean contamination instead of abandoning it.

briefs.headline: Structures need support
briefs.body: Buildings need support from the ground through their walls, columns, and spans. Add supports as you build outward; a large floating platform may not hold together.
briefs.action: Support a new span before extending it farther.

briefs.headline: Warnings mean someone is coming
briefs.body: Pillager scouts appear often, but full assaults are rarer and announced. Treat each warning as preparation time: fortify approaches, gather allies, and choose where the fight happens.
briefs.action: Prepare when an assault is warned.
